title: Pre-class brief (brief-writer output)
description: Strict output of the brief-writer subagent. The main agent validates it, drops pre_class_questions not found in Canvas text (fuzzy >= 0.9), and formats the Telegram message itself.

topic.description: What this class session is about, one line.

why_it_matters.description: Why this session matters in the arc of the course, 2-4 sentences.

key_arguments.description: Main arguments of the readings, each naming its reading.

prep_checklist.description: Concrete actions to take before class.

pre_class_questions.description: Only questions that Canvas actually asks, copied verbatim. Empty if none.

question.description: Verbatim question text from a Canvas assignment/page.

source.description: Title and/or URL of the Canvas assignment/page the question came from.

draft_answer.description: Draft for Chris to revise. Never submitted by the agent.
